show.description: When free-spirited Tara discovers a mysterious book that can alter destiny, her life becomes entangled with that of brooding businessman Dev Malhotra, whose tragic past is tied to the book’s dark secrets. As fates twist and choices blur, Tara and Dev must confront the ultimate question can you truly rewrite what’s written in the book of fate?
